work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act separates the Lovere/Lombardo-Venetian houses from Besançon, subjects them to diocesan ordinaries and retains privileges with stated exceptions, full derogation and closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9099–9099; the source closing at LF9249–9252 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quinta iunii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
